item.title: The Best & Brightest in Scottsdale
item.description: Now in its 42nd year, the Scottsdale Artists’ School is set to present "Best & Brightest," the annual juried art show and sale highlighting artworks created by its top students and alumni living around the world.

item.title: Collecting Art: A Moment of Pure Connection
item.description: This couple's collecting journey began with a shared love of vintage black-and-white photographs featuring such iconic figures as Frida Kahlo, Jacqueline Kennedy, and Paul McCartney.

item.title: Noah Davis Represented
item.description: Learn about a retrospective devoted to the Seattle-born artist Noah Davis, who had a humble aspiration: ‘to represent the people around me’.

item.title: Seeing Silence: Painting Despite War
item.description: Beloved in Nordic countries, Finnish painter Helene Schjerfbeck is relatively unknown to the rest of the world. Born in Helsinki, she witnessed civil war and two World Wars as well as the burgeoning of Finland’s national identity following independence from Russian rule in 1917. item.title: Kathy Anderson’s Artful Flowers
item.description: A florist is usually focused on creating symmetry, balancing colors and flowers in equal measure, with everything at its peak. These paintings, on the other hand, “look like a garden.”

item.title: John Hull > The Lowdown: The Lost Episodes
item.description: When artist John Hull ventured into a cemetery to gain inspiration for new work, stories started to develop and the characters gathered for the story that he wanted to tell.
